channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Tim Pawlenty: The crisis will subside in Minnesota, but trust will need to be rebuilt
item.description: We’ll all be part of that task. Here’s where efforts could be focused.

item.title: What’s it like to live in Minnesota right now? Life in the shadow of ICE.
item.description: We asked people how their lives have changed, or not changed.

item.title: Timberwolves send Mike Conley to Bulls to free up roster spot, money as trade deadline nears
item.description: Conley leaves Minnesota in a three-team deal with Detroit and Chicago as the Wolves position themselves for another move.

item.title: Renee Good’s brothers ask Congress to help change ICE, Border Patrol behavior
item.description: The brothers tell congressional forum that the family, like many others, has suffered “deep distress.”

item.title: Minneapolis Council committee delays liquor licenses for 2 hotels over hosting federal agents
item.description: The City Council will hold a public hearing on the liquor licenses for the Canopy by Hilton in the Mill District and Depot Renaissance Hotel.

item.title: Walz demands DHS stop detaining Minnesota children
item.description: In a letter to Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, Walz demanded details about how many Minnesota kids are in detention facilities.

item.title: Federal judge orders release of two men in ICE shooting charged with assaulting immigration agents
item.description: Defense attorneys cited photos in challenging the government’s account of when the agent fired a shot that wounded the fleeing suspect.

item.title: GOP bill aims to force Minnesota to hand over voter rolls to federal government
item.description: Secretary of State Steve Simon has so far mostly rebuffed federal data requests, a conflict that has escalated into a lawsuit.

item.title: The latest: Caucus results still coming in, giving look at voter sentiment on immigration enforcement
item.description: In addition to launching party organizing in this midterm election year, the meetings will give a snapshot of how voters are viewing President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown.

item.title: Minnesota sheriffs group, border czar Tom Homan negotiating blueprint for federal drawdown
item.description: Documents obtained by the Star Tribune show how county jails would give access to ICE agents, a key demand Homan has made to decrease the number of federal immigration agents in Minnesota.
